exams.notes: Examination to determine general knowledge of the trade; exemptions available under § 54.1-1131.
exams.quote: the applicant shall be required by Board regulations to take an oral or written examination to determine his general knowledge of the trade in which he desires licensure

interval_years.quote: A license for a tradesman shall be valid for three years from the date of issuance.

available.quote: the regulatory boards within the Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation shall, upon application by an individual, recognize licenses or certificates issued by another state as fulfillment of qualifications for licensure or government certification in the Commonwealth if the following conditions are met

requirements.value: Universal license recognition: must hold current valid license in another state for at least 3 years, other state required exam and standards, no pending investigations, good standing, no disqualifying criminal record, no discipline (except financial-only), and payment of fees.
requirements.quote: The individual holds a current and valid professional or occupational license or government certification in another state in a profession or occupation with a similar scope of practice

credential_type.quote: If the applicant successfully completes the examination, a license as a tradesman, liquefied petroleum gas fitter, or natural gas fitter provider, or a certificate as a backflow prevention device worker, shall be issued.

is_mandatory.quote: Beginning July 1, 1995, no individual shall engage in, or offer to engage in, work as a tradesman as defined in § 54.1-1128 unless he has been licensed under the provisions of this article.

title_protection.quote: Practicing or attempting to practice as a tradesman, liquefied petroleum gas fitter or natural gas fitter provider in the Commonwealth, except as provided for in this article, is prohibited and shall constitute the commission of a Class 1 misdemeanor.

scope_protection.quote: Practicing or attempting to practice as a tradesman, liquefied petroleum gas fitter or natural gas fitter provider in the Commonwealth, except as provided for in this article, is prohibited and shall constitute the commission of a Class 1 misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of statutes or regulations governing the practice of licensed tradesmen
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The Board shall have the power to require remedial education and to suspend, revoke or deny renewal of the certification or license of any individual who is found to be in violation of the statutes or regulations governing the practice of licensed tradesmen

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing as a tradesman without a license as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any building official who finds that an individual is practicing as a tradesman, elevator mechanic, liquefied petroleum gas fitter or natural gas fitter provider without a license as required by this article shall file a report to such effect with the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing incompetently as demonstrated by egregious or repeated violation of the Uniform Statewide Building Code
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any building official who has reason to believe that a tradesman, liquefied petroleum gas fitter or natural gas fitter provider is performing incompetently as demonstrated by an egregious or repeated violation of the Uniform Statewide Building Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation involving fraudulent or improper or dishonest conduct occurring during a declared state of emergency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If the Board finds any person licensed under the provisions of this chapter to be in violation of a statute or regulation involving fraudulent or improper or dishonest conduct as defined in § 54.1-1118, which violation occurred while engaged in a transaction initiated arising from a declared state of emergency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Substantial identity of interest with a contractor whose license has been revoked or not renewed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The Board may suspend, revoke, or deny renewal of an existing license or certificate, or refuse to issue a license or certificate, to any contractor who is shown to have a substantial identity of interest with a contractor whose license or certificate has been revoked or not renewed by the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of unemployment compensation or workers' compensation provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the Board may suspend, revoke or deny renewal of an existing license or certificate, or refuse to issue a license or certificate to any contractor who violates the provisions of Chapter 5 (§ 60.2-500 et seq.) of Title 60.2 and Chapter 8 (§ 65.2-800 et seq.) of Title 65.2.

bonding_required.quote: In lieu of compliance with subsection B, an applicant may demonstrate financial responsibility by electing to obtain and maintain a bond in the amount of $50,000.
